newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested on a live basis, compared to Monday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow, with demand and seller interest mostly light. Offerings were moderate. Confirmed - 500 Week Ago - 14,600 Year Ago - 29,800 Wk to Date - 3,800 Week Ago - 15,700 Year Ago - 34,800
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 100-1300 lbs 65.50-66.25. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1125 lbs pt ld 66.00 .

Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared to Mondays close - Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales. Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 2 lds 101.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs ld 102.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 98.00. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
